portable_payload: New candidate ZIP built with scripts.package.selected_files(), manifest verified before extraction; no installed dependencies, runtime records or Git directory copied. This candidate is not the final published ZIP.
fresh_environment_note: A new venv and node_modules were created in the extracted folder. Host download caches may be reused; installed application environments were not copied. Chromium uses the existing host Playwright browser cache. No dependency versions were changed.
